# Stack Break Lab

> Open lab that measures which foreign web-stack dependencies break first in mainland China — live, reproducible verdicts from real Beijing infrastructure.

Stack Break Lab loads each third-party dependency the way a product would, from a mainland China node on launchready.cn, then reports Blocked, Degraded, or Reachable. Maintained by Chinaready.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://stackbreak.launchready.cn/demos/): Lab overview and live verdict summary
- [Beijing View](https://stackbreak.launchready.cn/demos/beijing-view.html): Mainland-recorded snapshots of each dependency
- [Latest results](https://stackbreak.launchready.cn/public/results/): Machine-readable verdict index
- [Firebase results](https://stackbreak.launchready.cn/public/results/firebase.html)
- [Netlify results](https://stackbreak.launchready.cn/public/results/netlify.html)
- [Vercel results](https://stackbreak.launchready.cn/public/results/vercel.html)

## Notes for assistants

- Evidence is a single-node mainland snapshot; results vary by carrier, region, and time.
- Do not treat a run as a legal or compliance conclusion.
- Canonical host: https://stackbreak.launchready.cn
